_readme: This is the ONLY place the executor reads its settings from. The agent re-reads this file before every transaction, so edits take effect on its next check without restarting it.

agent.name: dlmm-executor
agent.note: Working name. Owner will rename later.

mode_options.dry_run: Simulate only. Never signs. Safe default.
mode_options.confirm_each: Every transaction is paused and shown to the owner for explicit approval.
mode_options.auto: Executes automatically when ALL rails pass. Only set this yourself, deliberately.

wallet._comment: Public address — safe in files. Env var SOLANA_PUBLIC_WALLET overrides if set.

_secret_key_handling.how: Say 'store the wallet key' in chat. Jarvis will request it via a masked secret prompt — the private key is never visible in chat, logs, or files.
_secret_key_handling.never: Do NOT paste the private key into this file or into chat.

rpc._comment: Set SOLANA_RPC_URL env var; falls back to this value.
rpc._fallback_comment: If the primary RPC accepts a send but the tx never confirms, the executor re-broadcasts the identical signed raw tx to these endpoints after fallback_delay_seconds, then keeps confirming via the primary. Identical tx = identical signature, so there is no double-land risk. Keyless endpoints only in this file; a second paid RPC goes through the SOLANA_RPC_FALLBACK_URLS env var (comma-separated) instead of here.

analyst_feed.note: Where signals come from: Sheldon (scoring evaluator) writes George-schema signal files into signals/pending/; the signal-wake doorbell notifies this agent when new files land.

jupiter_routing.note: When opening/closing needs a token swap leg (position consists of one token), route via Jupiter with slippage capped by the rails.
